# printf x | grep -q x   (comment-only line)
    # printf x | grep --quiet x
true || grep -q x file
true || { grep -q x file; }
printf x | grep -c x
printf x | grep -o x
printf x | grep -v x
printf x | grep x
printf x | grep -E 'a|b'
printf x | grep -- -q
grep -q x file
<<<"$v" grep -q x
printf x | awk '/q/ { exit }'
printf x |
  grep -c x
